summary: Iteration 6 testing complete: Encryption at Rest (PCI DSS) and BECS Direct Debit integration. All 16 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests verified Card/BECS toggle, BECS info banner, and BECS error handling.
critical_code_review_comments: Fernet (AES-128-CBC) encryption correctly implemented for bank details, DDR mandates, and payment methods
MongoDB stores encrypted values with 'gAAAAAB' prefix (Fernet token format)
API responses always return masked values (****XXXX format) - never raw or encrypted
Card numbers are NEVER stored - only last 4 digits retained (PCI DSS compliant)
BECS Direct Debit wired via Stripe Checkout but returns clear 400 error since test key doesn't support it
Frontend Payment Plan page correctly shows Card/BECS toggle with data-testid attributes
BECS info banner correctly displays when BECS is selected
Frontend gracefully handles BECS error with toast message and auto-switches to Card
Admin-only endpoints (/api/security/compliance-status, /api/admin/encrypt-existing-data) correctly require admin role
seed_data_creation: Test bank details, DDR mandates, and payment methods created with TEST_ prefix and cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6 testing complete. Encryption at rest implemented using Fernet (AES-128-CBC). All sensitive financial data (bank account numbers, routing numbers, BSB, provider account numbers) encrypted before MongoDB storage. API always returns masked values. BECS Direct Debit is wired but test Stripe key doesn't support it - returns clear 400 error. Card payments work. Previous iterations: 1 (29/29), 2 (45/45), 3 (66/66), 4 (18/18), 5 (12/12), 6 (16/16 new tests).

mocked_apis.becs_direct_debit: Wired via Stripe Checkout but returns 400 error - test Stripe key (sk_test_emergent) doesn't support BECS
mocked_apis.card_payments: Real Stripe checkout sessions created successfully
mocked_apis.encryption: Real Fernet encryption using ENCRYPTION_KEY from backend/.env
